mechanism: Hold one subject and one modular information grid completely stable while a dossier boots from absence to completeness in a strict hierarchy. Each phase activates a new semantic layer—identity, role, diagnostics, capability, equipment and status—while the subject performs only micro-motion. Information order, not camera travel, creates retention; subject, domain, panel geometry, palette and labels are variable.

invariants.rule: Begin with a partially hidden subject inside a fixed modular grid.
invariants.purpose: Creates an identity question and spatial memory.
invariants.ablation_failure: A fully revealed first frame removes the discovery ladder.

invariants.rule: Activate information layers in a semantic hierarchy from identity to capability.
invariants.purpose: Prevents visual noise and makes every phase answer one question.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random panel order produces decoration instead of explanation.

invariants.rule: Keep subject pose and grid geometry stable while module states change.
invariants.purpose: Makes progress attributable to the interface.
invariants.ablation_failure: Camera movement or pose changes destroy state comparison.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained accent color to indicate activation and completion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple competing activation colors blur hierarchy.

invariants.rule: End with one global active-state pulse after all key modules are complete.
invariants.ablation_failure: No final confirmation makes the boot feel unfinished.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject whose identity and silhouette remain stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One readable variable that changes monotonically or in countable stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: One restrained performance rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy the source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence that closes the causal chain.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting each state change.

anti_copy_exclusions: named ZENITH cybernetic operative and exact face
cyan-black tactical dossier with source panel arrangement
cybernetic arm diagnostic image and source stat values
source headings, labels, iconography and final slogan

instantiations.prompt_seed: Stable diver dossier with hierarchical module activation and one amber completion pulse.

instantiations.prompt_seed: Illustrated field archive booting from silhouette to clearance without camera movement.

instantiations.concept: A rescue drone is presented in a white industrial maintenance board that reveals chassis ID, sensor health, payload capacity, route map and launch-ready status.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Machine dossier with stable product pose and modular diagnostics.

failure_modes.repair: Stage identity, diagnostics, capabilities and equipment in separate phases.

failure_modes.failure: The camera or character constantly moves.
failure_modes.repair: Lock geometry and allow only breathing, eye or light micro-motion.

failure_modes.failure: Generated small text becomes the focus.
failure_modes.repair: Use large trusted labels or abstract icons and bars; keep microcopy secondary.
